Only the account owner can close a workspace. Go to Settings > Workspace > Close workspace. Before you close it, cancel any paid plan and export any data you want to keep.

After you close a workspace, it is recoverable for 30 days. To recover it, sign in and select "Reopen workspace." After 30 days, Ledgerly permanently deletes the workspace data. Deletion from backups finishes within 90 days.

Ledgerly keeps a copy of your subscription billing records for 7 years after closure to meet tax law requirements. This does not include your invoices or customer data.

If you have other workspaces, closing one does not affect the others.

---

[ACC-06] Managing multiple businesses
If you run more than one business, you can add each one as a separate workspace under a single sign-in. Use the workspace switcher in the top-left corner to move between them.

Each workspace has its own plan and its own bill. For example, one workspace can be on Growth while another is on Starter. Customers, invoices, and expenses do not move between workspaces, and reports cannot combine data from two workspaces.

The Scale plan includes up to 3 workspaces at no extra cost when they share the same billing card. Workspaces beyond 3 on Scale are billed at the full price of their own plan. Growth and Starter plans do not include extra workspaces.

To add a workspace, open the workspace switcher and select "New workspace."

---

[BIL-05] Failed subscription payments
If the card on file is declined when your Ledgerly subscription renews, Ledgerly retries the charge 3 times over 7 days: on day 1, day 3, and day 7 after the renewal date. The billing contact gets an email after each failed attempt.

During the 7-day retry window, the workspace keeps full access. If all 3 retries fail, the workspace moves to a restricted state: you can view and export data, but you cannot create or send new invoices.

A workspace stays restricted for up to 30 days. After 30 days without payment, it moves to the Starter plan. Data is never deleted because of a failed payment.

Updating your card during the retry window triggers an immediate new charge attempt.

---

[TEAM-04] Removing a team member
Account owners and admins can remove a team member from Settings > Team. The person loses access immediately and is signed out of all devices.

Invoices, expenses, and other records created by the removed person stay in the workspace. Their name still appears in the audit log.

Removing a user frees up their seat right away. If you pay for extra users, the billing change applies at your next renewal; Ledgerly does not refund the remaining part of the period for removed users.

If the removed person had connected Zapier, those Zaps stop working (INT-06).
